8f013a728bd8fcf9f2426e9a8db96405858b4458.sourceText: 它描述**雷达坐标轴与内部 IMU坐标轴怎样对应**。当前单位矩阵表示两路输入按轴向一致使用。整台 MID360斜装时，雷达与内部IMU一起倾斜，不能因此再把整机的-45°安装角填进这项。
8f013a728bd8fcf9f2426e9a8db96405858b4458.translatedText: It describes**how the radar coordinate axes correspond to the internal IMU coordinate axes**。The current identity matrix indicates that the two input channels are used with consistent axial directions\. When the entire MID360 is mounted at an angle, the radar and the internal IMU tilt together, so the \-45° mounting angle of the whole unit must not be filled into this item because of that\.
